propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py performs identical clean-source builds four times (install-from-sdist, wheel-from-sdist, sdist-content, empty-env failure), causing 35.93s module execution time due to repeated prerequisite build work.

A session-scoped per-worker fixture can build wheel and sdist once with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234, then expose immutable artifact paths to multiple test consumers without rebuilding identical prerequisites.

Wheel-from-sdist and sdist-content tests must retain their exact archive-content assertions while reusing shared read-only artifacts; install-from-sdist and empty-env must perform distinct real builds in function-scoped contexts.

The fixture refactor must preserve all existing real-artifact assertions, build boundaries, and provenance checks; a duplicate-build mutation or missing COMMIT corruption must fail the corresponding oracle.
Serial and xdist execution must pass with measurable before/after duration evidence; no cross-session cache, no production file changes, and no test assertions removed.
